name: ZhiNang.ai - AI assistant from anypage
description:
👨‍💻‍Github: https://github.com/aoao-eth/GPTNow.pro
🌐Website: https://gptnow.pro
🖥Chrome plugin: https://gptnow.pro/api/chrome

After installing this plug-in, when you browse any website, you can open the dialog box through the breathing ball in the lower right corner of the page, and chat with ChatGPT freely.

You can use our free $GPTCoin credits to chat directly for free (login required), or you can use your own apikey to chat.

In addition to the core dialogue features, we also support: (the list is still growing, and all features can be turned on and off in the settings)

Core: Question | Interpretation | Summary | Translation (EN) | Translation (Chinese)
Writing: Continuation | Polishing | Advertising | News | Headlines |
Email: write | reply | polish | headline |
Tools: Emoji | Domains | Google | Coding Experts

Newest feature: We support linking the current conversation directly and sharing it for anyone to view.

In addition, the most core, we hope to provide you with a silky and friendly dialogue experience:

1. Smooth stream dialogue display, support for forced interruption of dialogue at any time.
2. Silky smooth animation, elegant and beautiful interface, clear code highlighting.
3. Quickly copy content, clear content, and resend content.
4. Expand the dialog window at any time to display more content.
5. View history and share conversations.
6. Set up preset robots with different roles, or copy from the robots shared by others (under development).

For early users, we will set up an incentive mechanism, and everyone will build a community together. We hope that early users can get rewards and incentives from potential future profit opportunities. We will announce the specific mechanism when the function is fully prepared.

This plug-in and website are developed by individual developers. If you find it useful, you can share it with your friends. Thank you very much.
